rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Williamson synthesis: alkoxide + primary alkyl halide gives ethers.
Ethers are cleaved by excess HI to alkyl iodides and alcohol/water.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Aryl–oxygen bonds resist cleavage (resonance).  ·  Symmetrical ethers form by acid-catalysed dehydration of alcohols at 413 K.
